title: Off-Chain Integrations and Data Exchange
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Off-Chain Integrations and Data Exchange and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 13: Off-Chain Integrations and Data Exchange; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 13 roadmap: Smart Contracts and Off-Chain Applications; Connecting Contracts to Frontend Applications; Reading State and Sending Transactions from Applications; Connecting Wallets to Decentralized Applications; Provider and Signer Concepts; RPC Providers and Node Services; Transaction Submission and Confirmation; Retrieving and Filtering Event Logs; Indexing Blockchain Data for Applications; The Oracle Problem; Integrating External Data Through Oracles; Contract Interactions Across Application Boundaries; Handling Failed, Delayed, and Reorganized Transactions. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
